description:
Free FTP, SFTP and cloud storage client

FTP Rush is a free file transfer client for FTP, FTPS, SFTP and cloud storage, supporting Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Amazon S3 with a tabbed Explorer-like interface, drag and drop transfers, and C# scripting.
- Improvement - Added Japanese language.
- Improvement - Added long path support for local file operations.
- Improvement - Added long remote path support for FTP operations.
- Improvement - Improved Wing Web Client session recovery after timeout or transfer disconnect.
- Improvement - Fixed Wing Web Client download/upload issues on expired session.
- Improvement - Fixed some GUI issues.
